title: Irish Skillet Hash
description: A hearty, comforting hash made with tender potatoes, onions, and sometimes other cooked vegetables, often served with eggs, bacon or sausage, and sometimes with toast or other bread.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium heat.
Peel and dice the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes.
Add the diced potatoes to the preheated skillet.
Cook the potatoes for 10-12 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Stir the potatoes occasionally to prevent burning.
Once the potatoes are cooked, use a spatula to break them up into a crumbly hash.
Continue to cook the hash for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the hash with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
